items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: that’s where I first met Hal. I think he was the very first black friend I’ve ever had in my life.

ctx.x: What role did your Italian heritage have in this whole thing? I noticed that you were written about in a new book about jazz musicians and the Italian heritage.

Well you know we were, we were in a town that was mostly Irish American and we were the Sicilians. And we were pretty low on the totem pole. But it wasn’t in your face every day, because our group was pretty much among our ethnic neighbors and family. But you know the Italian thing I never really thought about it until I got into college. I didn’t know I was Italian until I got to college and someone called me a name. You know really, because we never thought about that. Everybody had a name like ours in our town…

were talking about Hal, that’s where I first met Hal. I think he was the very first black friend I’ve ever had in my life. Because in Mount Morris I think there was one black family. I think. Yeah, there was one black family in Mount Morris. Yeah.
